notes: Wake turbulence separation minima applied to aircraft in trail on final approach, in nautical miles. Categories are the ICAO legacy ones: L light, M medium, H heavy, J super. The figures follow ICAO Doc 4444 distance-based wake turbulence radar separation minima; where Doc 4444 gives no figure the radar minimum applies instead. Rows are the aircraft in front, columns the one behind.

approximated.note: Super behind super is taken as 4 NM; Doc 4444 does not publish a figure for it. Everything else in minimaNm is the published table.
